stories.evidence_text: Food Security in the U.S. | Economic Research Service Food security means access by all people at all times to enough food for an active, healthy life. ERS presents trends, statistics, and charts related to food security, along with definitions, background, key publications, and resources. stories.evidence_text: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania SNAP, formerly known as food stamps, provides food assistance to eligible low-income Pennsylvanians, offering EBT Cards to purchase fresh, healthy foods. Check your eligibility and apply online.
